name: Win Streak
description: Win most of the rounds in stage 2 and stage 3. Generally enter stage 4 with 80 HP or more.

name: Lose Streak
description: Lose streak for most of stage 2 and 3. Goal is to make as much gold as possible and obtain best-in-slot components off carousel. Typically only a good strategy with comps that have high late-game win potential.

name: Mystery Condition
description: What could it be! Used occasionally on site for UI guides as it will never become outdated from set updates.

name: Lots of Gold
description: High gold game due to an encounter, prismatic econ augment, multiple econ augments, a set mechanic that provides gold, or any other factor that increases the amount of gold you have beyond that of an average game.

name: {champion} from Orb
description: {champion} from stage 1 orb or from an early shop.

name: Early Taric
description: Taric before 3-5, ideally before 3-2 so you can select an augment that helps hit Leona 2 on 3-5.
